03 / ABOUT

When the noise fades,
you hear who you really are.

Yu Stellar is an independent musician from Taipei.

Working with delicate vocals, electronic textures, and a rhythm that moves like the night, Yu Stellar collects the emotions that flicker briefly through a city. The songs are about goodbyes that were never said out loud, and about people who choose to keep glowing even in the dark.

Every melody spends a long time in the mind before it's allowed to be spoken. Yu Stellar believes the most honest writing tends to happen in the quietest moments — a recording made on a phone at midnight, a lyric that catches in the throat halfway through rehearsal, a verse finished long before the chorus is.

There's no big production team here, and no chase for a flawless sound. What matters more is whether the thing that needed saying actually got said. If you've ever lain awake thinking of someone, or of something you never got to say, I hope the sound here can help you finally set it down.

Yu Stellar ✦
